Description: Allows you to perform all operations on all services except IAM.
Allows you to perform read-only operations on all services except IAM.
Allows you to perform any operation on all OBS resources under the account.
Allows you to list buckets, and obtain basic bucket information and bucket metadata.

Allows you to list buckets, obtain basic bucket information and bucket metadata, and list objects (excluding versioned objects).NOTEIf a user with this permission fails to list objects on OBS Console, there may be multiple versions of objects in the bucket. In this case, you need to grant the user the obs:bucket:ListBucketVersions permission so that the user can view different versions of objects on OBS Console.

Allows you to perform all operations defined in OBS ReadOnlyAccess and to perform basic object operations, such as uploading objects, downloading objects, deleting objects, and obtaining object ACLs.NOTEIf a user with this permission fails to list objects on OBS Console, there may be multiple versions of objects in the bucket. In this case, you need to grant the user the obs:bucket:ListBucketVersions permission so that the user can view different versions of objects on OBS Console.
